title: Script Editor, bookmarks or breakpoints added on history prev, next
body:
### Tested versions

### Reproducible in:
v4.8.dev4.official [b56a91878]
v4.8.dev3.official [51105ccbe]

### Not reproducible in:
v4.7.2.stable.official [ed1daf0bf]

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev4 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors (853x683 @ 60.02 Hz, 1920x1080 @ 60.00 Hz) - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Script Editor, bookmarks or breakpoints are added when navigating the cursor history (alt + left or right arrow), after:
- adding or removing lines above a bookmark or a breakpoint
- toggling off bookmarks or breakpoints
- removing all bookmarks or breakpoints

### Steps to reproduce

- open the project: [script_editor_breakpoint_added_on_history_next_prev.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31799591/script_editor_breakpoint_added_on_history_next_prev.zip)
- in the file system panel, double-click to open: new_script.gd
- click to the left of a line number in the middle of the script, to add a breakpoint (red dot)
- right-click on the word 'Node' on the first line
- choose: Lookup Symbol
- in the script editor's files panel click on: new_script.gd
- click on line 2
- press: enter
- hold: alt and press: left arrow (or press the history previous button in the script editors top right corner)
- the node documentation is shown
- hold: alt and press: left arrow
- new_script.gd in shown

### Issue
A second breakpoint has been added.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/84cc4c87-dd54-4628-8c2d-59736c4e5eb2

### Expected
Don't add breakpoints when navigating the history.

### Notes

The same thing happens with bookmarks.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/099eae68-5920-4eb5-9427-045128cef1f9

And the bookmarks or breakpoints return when navigating the history after toggling off or removing all bookmarks or breakpoints:
Go To > Bookmarks > Remove All Bookmarks
Go To > Breakpoints > Remove All Breakpoints

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6d0b3346-c596-42d5-968f-47e73cd24d15

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[script_editor_breakpoint_added_on_history_next_prev.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31799591/script_editor_breakpoint_added_on_history_next_prev.zip)
